stem: Which sentence describes the interaction of a white-tailed deer with both living and nonliving parts of its ecosystem?

options.label: A
options.text: The white-tailed deer hides behind a rock and uses the heat from the sun to stay warm.

options.label: B
options.text: The white-tailed deer protects its fawn from predators and shows the fawn how to find food.

options.label: C
options.text: The white-tailed deer rubs its antlers on a tree and eats leaves from the tree.

options.label: D
options.text: The white-tailed deer eats grass in a field and drinks water from a pond.
